Born in Bingham Canyon. In 1942, she married Thomas John Downard in Salt Lake City, joining the two family lines.

Norma married Thomas John Downard on June 26, 1942, in Salt Lake City, Utah, joining the Lambson and Downard branches. Their children were Robert, Glenn, and Quinn.
